name: quiz-master
description: Three complementary skills for a static quiz website: Lecture Analyzer extracts source-grounded topics and objectives; Quiz Master generates draft BankQuestion v2 items; Question Validator independently reviews each answer, option explanation, and citation before approval.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze lectures, generate questions, independently validate answers.
interface.longDescription: A three-skill question production toolkit for static HTML quiz applications. No server or education-level attribute required.
